sn35.77:1.1: yaṃ kho rādha dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.77:1.3: cakkhuṃ kho rādha dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.77:1.7: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā …pe… adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe…
sn35.77:1.12: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.77:1.13: yaṃ kho rādha dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti.
